name: The Blood Of Jesus
overview: The blood of Jesus is central to the believer's salvation, signifying the new covenant established through His sacrifice for the remission of sins, as Jesus Himself declared at the Last Supper. Scripture reveals that blood represents life and atonement, a truth foreshadowed in the Old Testament where the blood of the Passover protected God's people and was given on the altar to make atonement for souls. The New Testament affirms that the church is purchased by Christ's own blood, and through this blood believers are justified and saved from God's wrath. Jesus also emphasizes the necessity of partaking in His life through His blood to have eternal life within them.
